PERSONAL PROJECTS
Sallah bot (2025 - now)
- A Telegram bot written in Python that sends prayer-time reminders for the user's city; about 1,200 people use it.
- Runs on a small rented Ubuntu server that I set up myself and keep patched over SSH.
- Keeps each user's city and reminder choices in SQLite; I wrote the tables and the queries by hand.
- Tracked down a time-zone bug that sent Fajr reminders an hour late to users outside the Kingdom, and added a check so it cannot come back unnoticed.

Tutor Match (2026)
- A website where University of Tabuk students find a peer tutor for a course. The page is plain JavaScript; behind it a small Flask application answers the page's requests with the tutor list as JSON.
- The whole history is public: about 140 commits, one branch per feature, merged only after I had tried the feature on a test copy.
- 85 students signed up in the first term.
